name: Thinking Of You
source:
You and Tom are friends. Alice and Tom are friends. You and Alice like Tom.
A simple fluff story.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=17521]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
你和湯姆是朋友，愛麗絲和湯姆也是朋友。你和愛麗絲都喜歡湯姆。
一個簡單而甜蜜的故事。

［摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=17521]Lemma Soft論壇[/url]］
